content.text:
**The most prominent and detailed Cloudflare Workers-related incident report is from the major service outage on June 12, 2025.**[[1]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)

### Summary of the June 12, 2025 Outage
- **Duration**: 2 hours and 28 minutes (starting around 17:52 UTC).
- **Affected Services**: Primarily driven by a failure in the underlying storage infrastructure for **Workers KV**. This impacted many critical Cloudflare products, including:
  - Workers KV (core issue)
  - WARP, Access, Gateway
  - Images, Stream, Workers AI
  - Turnstile, Challenges, AutoRAG, Zaraz
  - Parts of the Cloudflare Dashboard
- **Impact on Workers**:
  - Workers KV experienced ~90.22% request failures (503/500 errors) for non-cached key-value pairs needing origin storage.
  - Workers and Workers for Platforms saw error rates peak at ~2% and ~10% respectively during the incident (due to a third-party dependency for uploads in some cases).
  - Workers KV relies on a central data store for its source of truth; its failure caused outages for cold reads/writes.
- **Root Cause**: Failure in the storage backend used by Workers KV. Part of this infrastructure depended on a third-party cloud provider that experienced an outage. Cloudflare acknowledged responsibility for architectural dependencies and noted they were already transitioning KV to more resilient infrastructure (with a coverage gap exposed here). No data loss, no security incident or attack involved.[[1]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)

Cloudflare published a full **post-incident report** on their blog, including timelines, detailed impact tables, what went wrong, and remediation steps. You can read the complete report here: [Cloudflare service outage June 12, 2025](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/).[[1]](https://blog.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-service-outage-june-12-2025/)

### Other Recent or Smaller Workers-Related Incidents
Cloudflare's status history and community posts mention several smaller or resolved issues involving Workers or Workers KV, such as:
- Increased errors for Workers KV requests (resolved August 13, 2026).[[2]](https://statusfield.com/services/cloudflare/incidents)
- 1022 errors for some Workers scripts (October 2025).[[3]](https://community.cloudflare.com/t/cloudflare-workers-issues/842539)
- Logpush issues for a subset of Workers (February 2024).[[4]](https://community.cloudflare.com/t/cloudflare-workers-issues/621958)
- Various other transient problems like Workers AI model errors, asset upload issues, or gradual deployments problems (mostly short-lived and resolved quickly).[[2]](https://statusfield.com/services/cloudflare/incidents)

For real-time or historical status, check [Cloudflare's Status Page](https://www.cloudflarestatus.com/) or their blog for official post-mortems.

If you're looking for a specific date, a different incident (e.g., a particular Workers KV outage, security report, or something more recent), or details on how to view abuse/incident reports in the dashboard, provide more context and I can refine the search.
